constraints.text: Keep v1 byte/schema/behavior compatibility and exact numeric admission. V2 must require exactly the declared field set and signed runtime_admission=controller-cid-boot-snapshot-v1, canonical bytes, bounded canonical mmcblkN without leading zeros, and physical commissioning with trusted-initramfs/recovery-handoff entry. Reject unknown modes/versions, extra fields, synthetic builder use and incompatible flags before mutation. Positive v2 fixtures belong only to isolated actual-C harnesses and disposable tests, never a physical builder fixture bypass. Existing shared preparation/staging consumers must prove signed policy digest and canonicalization preserve v2 without an unsigned switch.

Prove actual compiled behavior is bound to the signed v2 policy and reviewed executable/FIT, not only an unsigned manifest label or a policy digest string embedded in the wrong algorithm. Exercise relabeled v1/v2, changed runtime_admission, mismatched compiled policy/mode and actual embedded-member substitutions; prove refusals through preparation/build/composition/shared staging. Keep signed job/receipt formats and preflight/write purpose separation. Return any needed file/schema/compiled-record contract beyond the nine assigned files before editing.

Initialize the RAM snapshot once from the unique canonical user area of the signed controller/CID/type/capacity; subsequent checks compare that same snapshot and never replace it. Before any p5 mount or marker consumption, prove current p5 parent, dev_t, PARTUUID, start/size and signed map agreement. Revalidate snapshot/stable physical identity at marker and target/environment/transfer boundaries and bind all raw accesses to the admitted descriptor. Actual-C fixtures must cover both SD mmcblk2/RAM mmcblk0 and reverse mappings with different dev_t, wrong stable identity, duplicates and changed within-boot node/dev_t/controller/card/p5. Initial refusal cannot consume the marker; later refusal must retain the existing confirmed-consumption/unmount finalizer rules.

Preserve readonly preflight target opens, both exhausted job-bound environment checks, descriptor close/error paths and compile-time exclusion of target O_RDWR/image/environment transfer writes. Preserve full-writer source hashing, overlap/root/mount checks, GPT/8 GB layout, ordered two-copy environment handling, one-shot claim, expiry, original recovery and SD rescue, journal/marker-last staging and no automatic retry/rearm. Passing v2 offline checks cannot satisfy urh-04/05 or authorize real jobs, boot-policy changes or writes. Obtain high independent delivery verification and fresh exact-operation reviews/owner authority before physical use.

Report offline source/fixture evidence separately from sanitized measured hardware evidence. Record source/compiled-artifact provenance, bounded snapshot/path storage and incremental memory/binary impact; preserve existing FIT/load-memory and resource gates. Implementation scratch stays under512MiB and retained output under64MiB with no full-image copies, bulk/QEMU repeats or new dependencies. This reviewer lineage retains the separate two-run/300-second/256MiB diagnostic allowance, with no experimental runs used. Preserve the earlier research decision and historical evidence unchanged.

decision.rationale: Approved bounded offline v2 repair within the existing H12 goal; optional features remain paused. Before: scripts/build_h616_reimage_candidate.py:policy_fields, live_h616_recovery_stage.py:admitted_target and emmc_image_writer.c fix mmcblk0, refusing the sanitized 2026-09-30 SD measurement of mmcblk2/179:8 under 4022000.mmc with the recorded CID and capacity. After: explicit signed commissioning-policy-v2 preserves exact signed staging mapping and stable physical identity, while the RAM writer pins and revalidates one boot-local mapping. This resolves the first proposal's unsupported cross-boot numeric assumption without guessed hardware facts. Independently reviewed retained Linux host.c:532-540 dynamically allocates unaliased host indices; block.c:2637 derives the name from host index and 2560/2617 allocates minors separately. Their actual SHA-256 values remain 822afe61a72e267e8da974990548859272038d464cf8423f075836d160f60b8d and a671a8347246591a2589e10f6f25ca5d638b30d27430bb3528d484831b44bd42. All nine source-hashes.json entries were recomputed and matched. The coordinator's research.md identifies unmeasured RAM enumeration and alternatives: a separate numeric probe would add a physical boot without proving next-boot allocation, and DT aliases would not fix separately allocated minors. Reusing existing discovery and signing avoids those expansions. Actual accepted requirements were read: decision 0018 requires exact target identity and fail-closed overlap/capacity checks; live-handoff requires exact signed policy plus opened descriptor/current controller/CID/type/capacity/device number; preflight retains readonly descriptor, two raw exhausted environment records and compile-time exclusion of transfer writes; recovery-handoff requires current CID/dev_t, preservation, one-shot behavior and physical urh-04/05. They require exact identity within the running admission transaction, not a persistent Linux ordinal across independent boots. The explicitly signed v2 architecture changes the implementation contract while retaining those requirements; no owner scope/authority/spending/license change is introduced. Existing prepare-job and staging code import the shared policy parser, verify canonical bytes and signed policy digest; compiled-purpose evidence binds that digest, and actual FIT embedded-member checks already exist. Mode/compiled behavior and snapshot-to-p5-before-marker checks must nevertheless be proven under the constraints below. No implementation or physical acceptance is claimed. Board revision remains owner-reported; RAM enumeration/entry, physical recovery and cold RTC retention remain unknown. Source baseline is 5b740dd343081c0379b5ea283b0b62540ad43bfa plus amended coordinator proposal/record. Earlier needs-research decision and original proposal remain preserved. This session performed source/sanitized evidence reads and schema validation only: no experimental runs, production edits, hardware/development connections, credential or private-backup reads. Approval grants no physical authority.
